callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.from_proj_dir
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a string representing the path to an existing project directory
callees.post_condition: Returns a CodeGraphExtractor instance initialized for the given project directory and ready to answer extraction queries, or None if the CodeGraph backend is unavailable or cannot be initialized for this project

callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.get_function_spans
callees.pre_condition: language is a string identifying a supported language (e.g., "typescript"); filepath is the absolute path to a source file; the CodeGraphExtractor instance has been successfully initialized for the project
callees.post_condition: Returns a list of tuples (name: str, start_idx: int, end_idx: int) describing the zero-based inclusive line spans of functions in the given file, or None if the file is not indexed by CodeGraph
